title: Risk Assessment
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the existing_workflow path (FR-032, AI §9.1). Rendered from the Stage 6W findings.

EVERY RISK NAMES A COMPONENT AND A MITIGATION. FR-032 states it and DB §4.3 enforces it with a NOT NULL column: a risk that cannot name what it affects cannot be stored. Both fields are required here for the same reason — a risk register of unattributed risks is a list of worries.

Severity and likelihood are the 1-5 integer scales of docs/09 §2. Score and band are derived at presentation, never stored, so they are absent here.

risks.description: May be empty — a sound workflow carries no risks, and says so.

no_risks_statement.description: Present when risks is empty, carrying FR-021's explicit soundness statement.
